title: New Ends
description: This mod adds new ores, tools, armor and more to minecraft.
body:
This is a mod that adds new ores, tools, weapons, armor and more.

 

This mod adds Rubium. This is an ore that contains the sealed power of the anctient builders. this is a material that is a post-iron ore that is stronger than netherite. It is found in the overworld and in large quantities, this makes it quite cheap.

  

This is a work-in-progress mod. Please tell me what you would like me to add, it will help me release the next version and you will recive shoutuots for the idea.

 

This mod is currently for Neoforge, minecraft version: 1.21.4
